MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #10
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 57
   B. 15
   C. 1
   D. 56

2. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 40.5
   B. 10
   C. 81
   D. 9

3. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 36
   C. 12
   D. 24

4. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19.7
   C. 19
   D. 25

5. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 16
   C. 8
   D. 0

6. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 77
   C. 22
   D. 18

7. Solve for x: x + 3 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 11
   C. 14
   D. 3

8. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/2
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

9. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

10. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 29
   C. 23.6
   D. 23

11. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 44
   B. 105
   C. 30
   D. 22

12. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 40
   C. 13
   D. 41

13. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 49
   C. 7
   D. 50

14. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 7
   C. 1
   D. 7

15. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

16. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 5
   C. 24
   D. 25

17. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 36
   C. 81
   D. 18

18. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

19. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 10

20. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 37

21. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.025
   C. 0.205
   D. 0.25

22. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27
   C. 33
   D. 27.7

23. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 12
   C. 32
   D. 33

24. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 1

25. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

26. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 2/3
   C. 3/4
   D. 1/4

27. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 24

28. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

29. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

30. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 10

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

33. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

39. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
